cat <<'EOF' > plus_comm.v
Require Import Arith.

Theorem plus_comm : forall n m : nat,
  n + m = m + n.
Proof.
  intros n m.
  induction n as [| n' IHn'].
  - simpl.
    rewrite <- plus_n_O.
    reflexivity.
  - simpl.
    rewrite IHn'.
    rewrite plus_n_Sm.
    reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF
coqc plus_comm.v && ls -la plus_comm.vo

printf 'Require Import plus_comm.
Print Assumptions plus_comm.
Check plus_comm.
' | coqtop -quiet 2>&1 | head -20
